read: The board leans down: BTC sits under its broken 1d range low on volRatio 2.2 and most alts have 1d rangePos under 0.3 with neutral funding. The largest imbalance is HL-local funding in ZRO, UNI and PONS, far above CEX on price-only or short-covering moves.

watchlist.arms: 4h rejection back under the 4h high20 with funding staying above 30 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

brief: Delta: BTC is still under its broken 1d low20 (volRatio 2.2) and the board is mostly 1d down trends with neutral funding. XPL crowding faded (funding 72.16 to 29.69, premium 10.87 to 3.51 bps), so we cancel it per L2. AAVE and UNI shorts stopped earlier; ZRO funding is back at 70.59, so the crowded-fade idea stays on the watchlist until a rejection. One new plan: DOGE pullback short into the 1d sma20, low-confidence and base case is it may not fill. Tail case: a BTC reclaim of the 1d low20 would put the open shorts back inside their ranges. Gap: hl-cycles is stale (4.9 h).
